items.title: 阿尔及利亚｜中国与当地联合体获约11亿美元铁路合同
items.title_en: Algeria | Chinese-local consortium wins approximately US$1.1bn railway contract
items.summary: 阿尔及利亚铁路开发机构向中阿联合体授予Ghardaia–El Meniaa铁路约230公里标段合同，报道合同金额约11亿美元。
items.summary_en: Algerian rail authorities reportedly awarded a roughly 230km Ghardaia–El Meniaa rail contract worth around US$1.1bn to a Chinese-local consortium.
items.why_it_matters: 合同授予使项目进入承包执行与供应链开发阶段。
items.why_it_matters_en: An award creates potential downstream construction and supply-chain needs.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注铁路材料、桥涵、混凝土、机械及施工物流。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track railway materials, civil structures, concrete, construction machinery and logistics.

items.title: 阿曼｜OMRAN签署约1.15亿美元住宅开发协议
items.title_en: Oman | OMRAN signs approximately US$115m residential development agreements
items.summary: OMRAN与Grova Developments签署马斯喀特Madinat Al Irfan两项住宅开发协议，总开发价值约OMR44.5m（约US$115m）；Hassan Allam Construction被指定负责施工。
items.summary_en: OMRAN and Grova Developments signed two Madinat Al Irfan residential development agreements, together valued around OMR44.5m (US$115m), with Hassan Allam Construction identified as contractor.
items.why_it_matters: 已明确开发与施工主体，适合后续工程采购对接。
items.why_it_matters_en: Named developers and contractor create a concrete route for supplier engagement.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注门窗、卫浴、家具、石材、照明和机电装修。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track doors, sanitaryware, furniture, stone, lighting, MEP and fit-out.

items.title: 巴林｜Honeywell获GPIC芳烃综合体技术与工程合同
items.title_en: Bahrain | Honeywell selected for GPIC aromatics complex technology and engineering
items.summary: 报道称GPIC选定Honeywell UOP参与Sitra新芳烃综合体技术许可及工程服务，计划年产约120万吨对二甲苯及50万吨苯。
items.summary_en: GPIC reportedly selected Honeywell UOP for technology licensing and engineering on its proposed Sitra aromatics complex, targeting approximately 1.2m tpa of paraxylene and 0.5m tpa of benzene.
items.why_it_matters: 技术合同进展值得跟进，但不能据此认定大型施工包已经授予。
items.why_it_matters_en: Engineering selection is an early milestone, not confirmation of main construction award.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注阀门、管道、仪表、电气及工业工程配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track valves, piping, instrumentation, electricals and industrial works.

items.title: 突尼斯｜50MW光伏及储能项目招标线索
items.title_en: Tunisia | 50MW solar and battery storage tender lead
items.summary: 据10月13日项目报道，突尼斯出现50MW光伏及配套储能项目招标线索；招标单位、储能容量和截止日期尚待核验。
items.summary_en: A 13 October report indicates a tender lead for a 50MW Tunisian solar project with battery storage; authority, BESS sizing and deadline remain to be verified.
items.why_it_matters: 当前属于待核实的招标线索，尚不应视作具备完整投标文件的正式采购机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: This remains a procurement lead pending primary-source verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注光伏组件、逆变器、储能设备、变压器及EPC。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track PV, inverters, batteries, transformers and EPC.

items.title: 阿联酋｜迪拜地铁Gold Line六家联合体进入资格预审
items.title_en: UAE | Six consortia submit Dubai Metro Gold Line prequalification
items.summary: 据10月13日报道，六家联合体为迪拜地铁Gold Line总承包递交资格预审文件，部分团队含中国建筑及轨道工程企业；尚未形成主合同中标。
items.summary_en: Six consortia reportedly submitted prequalification documents for the Dubai Metro Gold Line, including teams with Chinese construction and rail companies; no main construction contract has been awarded.
items.why_it_matters: 预审阶段适合提前建立合作关系，而非宣称总包已落地。
items.why_it_matters_en: The PQ phase supports early partner mapping, not claims of awarded packages.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注轨道材料、车站装修、机电、机械与现场劳务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track trackwork, stations, MEP, machinery and site labour.

items.title: 莫桑比克｜8900万美元农村通信基础设施招标
items.title_en: Mozambique | US$89m rural telecommunications infrastructure tender
items.summary: 莫桑比克INCM据报公布约8900万美元农村电信基础设施供货、安装、调试及用户终端设备招标，编号INCM/CP/109/2026，所列截止日为11月13日；投标须核验官方文件。
items.summary_en: INCM reportedly announced a US$89m tender for rural telecoms infrastructure supply, installation and commissioning and user devices, reference INCM/CP/109/2026, with a reported 13 November deadline; bidders should check official documents.
items.why_it_matters: 潜在项目包含设备及现场安装，具备系统供应商和本地交付机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: Potential scope spans equipment and field delivery.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注通信基站、网络设备、太阳能供电、电缆和安装施工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track towers, network gear, solar power, cables and installation.

items.title: 科威特｜KOC天然气出口管道建设招标
items.title_en: Kuwait | KOC gas export pipeline construction tender
items.summary: MEED报道称Kuwait Oil Company开展BS-171增压站至Intermediate Slug Catcher设施约24英寸天然气出口管道项目招标，截止日期尚未核实。
items.summary_en: MEED reports a KOC tender for a 24-inch gas export pipeline from BS-171 to the Intermediate Slug Catcher facility; the bid deadline has not been independently confirmed.
items.why_it_matters: 油气管道工程将涉及专业材料和安装；应先核对采购文件。
items.why_it_matters_en: The pipeline could require specialist supply and installation, subject to procurement verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注钢管、阀门、焊接、防腐、检测和安装施工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track steel pipe, valves, welding, coating, inspection and installation.

items.title: 墨西哥｜跨洋走廊国际货运通关新规
items.title_en: Mexico | Interoceanic Corridor cross-border freight customs rules updated
items.summary: 墨西哥跨洋走廊针对Coatzacoalcos和Salina Cruz等港口的国际过境货物通关公布新规定，涉及港口、铁路和跨境物流衔接。
items.summary_en: Mexico announced customs provisions affecting internationally transiting cargo through Coatzacoalcos and Salina Cruz on the Interoceanic Corridor, relevant to port, rail and cross-border logistics.
items.why_it_matters: 属于物流制度变化，不是工程招标或已落实采购订单。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a trade-facilitation development, not a construction tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注清关、保税物流、港口服务与多式联运。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track customs, bonded logistics, port services and multimodal freight.
